name: nauth-toolkit
description: Embedded authentication library for Node.js — NestJS, Express, Fastify

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "if(!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_execpath||'')){console.error('
ERROR: This monorepo requires pnpm, not npm or yarn!
Please use: pnpm install
');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/core run clean && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/core run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:recaptcha && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build:nestjs && pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:client-angular && pnpm run build:providers
scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/database-typeorm-postgres run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/database-typeorm-mysql run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/email-console run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/email-nodemailer run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/sms-console run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/sms-aws-sns run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/sms-twilio run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/storage-database run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/storage-redis run build
scripts.build:providers: pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/social-google run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/social-apple run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/social-facebook run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/mfa-totp run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/mfa-sms run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/mfa-email run build && pnpm --filter @nauth-toolkit/mfa-passkey run build
scripts.clean: find packages -type d -name 'node_modules' -prune -o -type d -name 'dist' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true && find packages -type d -name 'node_modules' -prune -o -type f -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' run lint:fix && pnpm run format
